item.title: Civil Aviation Minister Reviews Winter Fog Preparedness for Safe and Smooth Flight Operations
item.description: Union Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu reviews winter fog preparedness with airlines, DGCA, AAI, and CISF. Emphasis on SOP compliance, real-time coordination, qualified crew deployment, and timely passenger communication to ensure safe, seamless operations.

item.title: Akhilesh Yadav Slams BJP, Signals South India Alliance and Emphasizes AI in Vision India
item.description: Akhilesh Yadav attacks BJP over Vande Mataram issue, signals alliance with KCR-KTR in South India, highlights AI’s impact at Vision India event, and raises concerns over 3 crore missing voters in UP, urging Election Commission transparency.

item.title: Trump Warns Russia-Ukraine War Could Spark World War III, Calls for Immediate Action
item.description: US President Donald Trump warns that the Russia-Ukraine conflict could escalate into World War III, highlights 25,000 recent deaths, urges immediate ceasefire, and signals US support for Ukraine under security agreements while emphasizing real action over talks.

item.title: Civil Aviation Minister: Year-Round Airfare Cap Not Feasible, Market-Driven Pricing Essential
item.description: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu says year-round airfare caps are impractical; DGCA monitors airline fares for transparency, while increasing capacity during high-demand periods is the real solution, ensuring passenger relief and balanced market growth.

item.title: Anupamaa Fans Excited as Gaurav Khanna May Return Post Bigg Boss 19 Win
item.description: Fans of ‘Anupamaa’ anticipate Gaurav Khanna’s return as Anuj after his Bigg Boss 19 victory. His birthday party with producer Rajan Shahi hints at reconciled differences and a potential comeback in the show.

item.title: Rebuilding Gaza Must Be the World’s Priority to Achieve Lasting Peace
item.description: The conflict in Gaza has exposed political failures, humanitarian crises, and global inaction. Rebuilding Gaza, resolving political disputes, and restoring human rights protections are essential for long-term peace and stability in the Israel-Palestine region.

item.title: Russia Rewrites Middle East Power Balance as Western Sanctions Falter
item.description: Russia, despite economic sanctions and pressure from the West, is strengthening its foothold in the Middle East through strategic partnerships, energy trade, and diplomatic manoeuvring. Its growing influence highlights shifting global power dynamics and the limitations of Western isolation efforts.

item.title: Dr. Shaifali Garg Unveils Her Profound Work on Vedic Astrology and Nakshatras in Delhi
item.description: A remarkable book launch in New Delhi unveiled Dr. Shaifali Garg’s insightful work “Tare Bolte Hain.” This book explores the deep significance of 27 nakshatras, offering readers spiritual clarity, astrological guidance, and a new perspective on life’s journey.

item.title: GOAT in India: Lionel Messi’s three-days spectacular tour in India, These cities await the football legend
item.description: Football legend Lionel Messi is back in India after 14 years for a three-day, four-city tour from December 13-15. Fans in Kolkata, Hyderabad, Mumbai, and Delhi will witness friendly matches, star-studded events, and exclusive meet-and-greet sessions with the GOAT himself.

item.title: GOAT in India: Shah Rukh Khan meets Lionel Messi with son, Video goes viral
item.description: Football legend Lionel Messi created a frenzy in Kolkata as he virtually unveiled his 70-foot-tall statue at Salt Lake Stadium and shared a warm moment with Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan. Fans chanted “Messi, Messi!”
